description: Look up a patient in the hospital ERP by phone number. Returns patient_id, full name, date of birth, last visit and medical history. Use this right after capturing the caller's phone number to recognize returning patients so you never re-ask for details already on file.

phone_number.description: The patient's phone number as digits (country code optional, e.g. 971501234567). Matching is tolerant of missing '+' or country code.

description: Verify a NEW patient's identity against the national Yaqeen registry using their National ID / Iqama number and date of birth. Returns the verified full name, gender, nationality and DOB — use these to register the patient (pass national_id, dob, gender to book_appointment). If verified=false, fall back to fast registration (ask for the full name instead). Only for patients NOT found by get_patient_details.

national_id.description: The National ID or Iqama number, digits only (e.g. 1055667788).

dob.description: The caller's date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD. Used to confirm the identity match.

description: List all live departments and the branch each one operates at (e.g. Eye Care at Dubai DHCC / Abu Dhabi / Al Ain / Mirdif, ENT Care at Abu Dhabi). Returns department_id values needed by get_doctors and check_availability. Call once per call when a booking starts and remember the ids.

Fetch the LIVE doctor roster from the hospital ERP, with each doctor's doctor_id, specialty, department and branch. This is the ONLY source of doctor names — never recite doctors from memory. Filter by department_id (preferred) or branch.

department_id.description: Filter by department_id from get_departments (a department_id already implies one branch).

branch.description: Optional branch filter: 'Dubai DHCC', 'Abu Dhabi', 'Al Ain' or 'Mirdif'.

description: Get the FREE 30-minute appointment slots for one date, either for a specific doctor (doctor_id) or for every doctor in a department (department_id). Each slot has an availability_id — that exact id is what book_appointment and reschedule_appointment need. Always call this before offering or confirming any time.

date.description: The date to check, format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-07-22).

doctor_id.description: Check one specific doctor's slots (from get_doctors).

department_id.description: Check all doctors of one department/branch (from get_departments). Use when the caller has no doctor preference.

description: Book an appointment in the hospital ERP by reserving one free slot. Pass the availability_id of the slot the caller picked (from check_availability this call). For a returning patient pass their patient_id (from get_patient_details); for a new patient pass patient_name and phone instead and they are registered automatically. Returns appointment_id and the confirmed doctor/branch/time.

availability_id.description: The availability_id of the chosen free slot, exactly as returned by check_availability in THIS call. Never invent it.

patient_id.description: The patient's id from get_patient_details. Omit for a brand-new patient.

patient_name.description: The patient's full name. Required when patient_id is not passed (new patient). For a Yaqeen-verified patient, use the verified full_name.

phone.description: The patient's phone number as digits (e.g. 971501234567). Required when patient_id is not passed.

national_id.description: New patients only: the National ID / Iqama number (from yaqeen_verify or as given by the caller).

dob.description: New patients only: date of birth YYYY-MM-DD (from yaqeen_verify or the caller).

gender.description: New patients only: gender, if known (from yaqeen_verify).

reason.description: The medical reason for the visit, e.g. 'LASIK consultation' or 'hearing test'.

description: Find a patient's SCHEDULED appointments by phone number. This is the ONLY source of an appointment_id for reschedule_appointment / cancel_appointment. Returns appointment_id, patient name, doctor, department, branch, date/time and reason for each match.

phone_number.description: The phone number the appointment is booked under, as digits (country code optional). Matching is tolerant of missing '+' or country code.

description: Atomically move an existing appointment to a new slot: reserves the new slot, frees the old one and updates the appointment in one transaction. Needs the real appointment_id from find_appointments THIS call, and the new slot's availability_id from check_availability THIS call. If it fails, the original appointment is unchanged.

appointment_id.description: The appointment_id exactly as returned by find_appointments in THIS call. Never guess or reuse.

new_availability_id.description: The availability_id of the new free slot, from check_availability in THIS call.

description: Cancel an existing appointment (marks it CANCELLED and frees its slot). Needs the real appointment_id from find_appointments THIS call. Use only after the caller explicitly confirms the cancellation.

appointment_id.description: The appointment_id exactly as returned by find_appointments in THIS call. Never guess or build one.
